title: Product Map UX rescue pass
summary: Turn the Product Map from function-emitted to usable-every-day: sticky styled controls, collapsed-by-default buckets, jump-nav, per-status mini counts, hash-encoded open buckets, live-refresh persistence via stable data-doc-id, and a lazy first-load payload that ships only bucket-heading skeletons.
approach: Restyle pm-controls with the viewer indigo/rounded tokens. Wrap each bucket in <details class="pm-bucket"> with a summary carrying label + count + per-status mini pills. Emit a pm-jump-nav chip row per grouping. Extend the hash schema to carry &open=<bucketIds>. Suppress raw-JSON disclosures inside pm-req cards via a suppressRawJson flag on renderReq/renderUserStory. Add a /product-map/<name> partial endpoint; the client fetches groupings on demand and invalidates the cache on every SSE swap.
